name: Cookiemate
author: Brainywp

sections.description:
Cookiemate is a clean and performance-focused WordPress cookie banner plugin. We designed it to help you manage cookie notices with easy-to-use steps. You can stay compliant with privacy regulations with this plugin. Cookiemate allows you to display a customizable cookie consent banner on your website with just a few clicks.

With Cookiemate, you can easily enable or disable the cookie banner, customize the message and button text, show or hide the close button. It ensures a smooth user experience on both desktop and mobile devices. It is perfect for website owners who want a fast, easy, and reliable cookie management solution without unnecessary complexity.

Features

  • Easy-to-enable cookie consent banner
  • Customizable message and button text
  • Option to show or hide the close button
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Mobile-friendly design
  • One-click enable or disable option

If you find the plugin helpful, please consider rating us.

A review only takes a moment of your valuable time, but it means a lot to us.

You can (share your experience here)[https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/cookiemate/reviews/#new-post]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your wp-content/plugins directory, or install it directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page to configure your cookie banner.
sections.faq:
What is Cookiemate?

Cookiemate is a lightweight cookie consent banner plugin for WordPress that helps websites comply with privacy and cookie regulations.

How do I install Cookiemate?

You can install it through your WordPress dashboard by searching for “Cookiemate” or by uploading the plugin ZIP file manually.

Can I customize the cookie banner?

Yes, you can customize the banner message, button text, and behavior directly from the plugin settings.

Is Cookiemate free?

Yes, Cookiemate is completely free to use.
